-- Name: custom_oauth_providers; Type: TABLE; Schema: auth; Owner: supabase_auth_admin
--

CREATE TABLE auth.custom_oauth_providers (
    id uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
    provider_type text NOT NULL,
    identifier text NOT NULL,
    name text NOT NULL,
    client_id text NOT NULL,
    client_secret text NOT NULL,
    acceptable_client_ids text[] DEFAULT '{}'::text[] NOT NULL,
    scopes text[] DEFAULT '{}'::text[] NOT NULL,
    pkce_enabled boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
    attribute_mapping jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb NOT NULL,
    authorization_params jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb NOT NULL,
    enabled boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
    email_optional boolean DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
    issuer text,
    discovery_url text,
    skip_nonce_check boolean DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
    cached_discovery jsonb,
    discovery_cached_at timestamp with time zone,
    authorization_url text,
    token_url text,
    userinfo_url text,
    jwks_uri text,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT custom_oauth_providers_authorization_url_https CHECK (((authorization_url IS NULL) OR (authorization_url ~~ 'https://%'::text))),
    CONSTRAINT custom_oauth_providers_authorization_url_length CHECK (((authorization_url IS NULL) OR (char_length(authorization_url) <= 2048))),
    CONSTRAINT custom_oauth_providers_client_id_length CHECK (((char_length(client_id) >= 1) AND (char_length(client_id) <= 512))),
    CONSTRAINT custom_oauth_providers_discovery_url_length CHECK (((discovery_url IS NULL) OR (char_length(discovery_url) <= 2048))),
    CONSTRAINT custom_oauth_providers_identifier_format CHECK ((identifier ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9:-]{0,48}[a-z0-9]$'::text)),
    CONSTRAINT custom_oauth_providers_issuer_length CHECK (((issuer IS NULL) OR ((char_length(issuer) >= 1) AND (char_length(issuer) <= 2048)))),
    CONSTRAINT custom_oauth_providers_jwks_uri_https CHECK (((jwks_uri IS NULL) OR (jwks_uri ~~ 'https://%'::text))),
    CONSTRAINT custom_oauth_providers_jwks_uri_length CHECK (((jwks_uri IS NULL) OR (char_length(jwks_uri) <= 2048))),
    CONSTRAINT custom_oauth_providers_name_length CHECK (((char_length(name) >= 1) AND (char_length(name) <= 100))),
    CONSTRAINT custom_oauth_providers_oauth2_requires_endpoints CHECK (((provider_type <> 'oauth2'::text) OR ((authorization_url IS NOT NULL) AND (token_url IS NOT NULL) AND (userinfo_url IS NOT NULL)))),
    CONSTRAINT custom_oauth_providers_oidc_discovery_url_https CHECK (((provider_type <> 'oidc'::text) OR (discovery_url IS NULL) OR (discovery_url ~~ 'https://%'::text))),
    CONSTRAINT custom_oauth_providers_oidc_issuer_https CHECK (((provider_type <> 'oidc'::text) OR (issuer IS NULL) OR (issuer ~~ 'https://%'::text))),
    CONSTRAINT custom_oauth_providers_oidc_requires_issuer CHECK (((provider_type <> 'oidc'::text) OR (issuer IS NOT NULL))),
    CONSTRAINT custom_oauth_providers_provider_type_check CHECK ((provider_type = ANY (ARRAY['oauth2'::text, 'oidc'::text]))),
    CONSTRAINT custom_oauth_providers_token_url_https CHECK (((token_url IS NULL) OR (token_url ~~ 'https://%'::text))),
    CONSTRAINT custom_oauth_providers_token_url_length CHECK (((token_url IS NULL) OR (char_length(token_url) <= 2048))),
    CONSTRAINT custom_oauth_providers_userinfo_url_https CHECK (((userinfo_url IS NULL) OR (userinfo_url ~~ 'https://%'::text))),
    CONSTRAINT custom_oauth_providers_userinfo_url_length CHECK (((userinfo_url IS NULL) OR (char_length(userinfo_url) <= 2048)))
);

    invited_at timestamp with time zone,
    confirmation_token character varying(255),
    confirmation_sent_at timestamp with time zone,
    recovery_token character varying(255),
    recovery_sent_at timestamp with time zone,
    email_change_token_new character varying(255),
    email_change character varying(255),

    raw_user_meta_data jsonb,

    created_at timestamp with time zone,
    updated_at timestamp with time zone,
    phone text DEFAULT NULL::character varying,
    phone_confirmed_at timestamp with time zone,
    phone_change text DEFAULT ''::character varying,
    phone_change_token character varying(255) DEFAULT ''::character varying,
    phone_change_sent_at timestamp with time zone,

--
-- Name: v_attendance_summary; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: postgres
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_attendance_summary AS
 SELECT ar.student_id,
    s.usn,
    u.full_name AS student_name,
    o.offering_id,
    sub.subject_code,
    sub.subject_name,
    count(*) AS total_sessions,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((ar.status)::text = 'PRESENT'::text)) AS present,
    round(((100.0 * (count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((ar.status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['PRESENT'::character varying, 'LATE'::character varying])::text[]))))::numeric) / (NULLIF(count(*), 0))::numeric), 2) AS attendance_pct
   FROM ((((((public.attendance_records ar
     JOIN public.attendance_sessions asess ON ((asess.session_id = ar.session_id)))
     JOIN public.subject_offerings o ON ((o.offering_id = asess.offering_id)))
     JOIN public.curriculum_structures cs ON ((cs.curriculum_id = o.curriculum_id)))
     JOIN public.subjects sub ON ((sub.subject_id = cs.subject_id)))
     JOIN public.students s ON ((s.student_id = ar.student_id)))
     JOIN public.users u ON ((u.user_id = s.user_id)))
  GROUP BY ar.student_id, s.usn, u.full_name, o.offering_id, sub.subject_code, sub.subject_name;


ALTER VIEW public.v_attendance_summary OWNER TO postgres;

--
-- Name: v_current_enrollments; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: postgres
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_current_enrollments AS
 SELECT e.enrollment_id,
    s.student_id,
    s.usn,
    u.full_name AS student_name,
    sub.subject_code,
    sub.subject_name,
    sub.credits,
    uf.full_name AS primary_faculty,
    o.status AS offering_status,
    e.status AS enrollment_status
   FROM (((((((public.student_subject_enrollments e
     JOIN public.students s ON ((s.student_id = e.student_id)))
     JOIN public.users u ON ((u.user_id = s.user_id)))
     JOIN public.subject_offerings o ON ((o.offering_id = e.offering_id)))
     JOIN public.curriculum_structures cs ON ((cs.curriculum_id = o.curriculum_id)))
     JOIN public.subjects sub ON ((sub.subject_id = cs.subject_id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.faculty_subject_allocations fa ON (((fa.offering_id = o.offering_id) AND ((fa.role)::text = 'PRIMARY'::text))))
     LEFT JOIN public.users uf ON ((uf.user_id = fa.faculty_user_id)));


ALTER VIEW public.v_current_enrollments OWNER TO postgres;

--
-- Name: v_faculty_workload; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: postgres
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_faculty_workload AS
 SELECT fsa.faculty_user_id,
    u.full_name AS faculty_name,
    o.term_id,
    o.academic_year_id,
    count(DISTINCT o.offering_id) AS total_offerings,
    sum(sub.theory_hours) FILTER (WHERE ((sub.subject_type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['THEORY'::character varying, 'THEORY_LAB'::character varying])::text[]))) AS total_theory_hours,
    sum(sub.lab_hours) FILTER (WHERE ((sub.subject_type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['LAB'::character varying, 'THEORY_LAB'::character varying])::text[]))) AS total_lab_hours
   FROM ((((public.faculty_subject_allocations fsa
     JOIN public.subject_offerings o ON ((o.offering_id = fsa.offering_id)))
     JOIN public.curriculum_structures cs ON ((cs.curriculum_id = o.curriculum_id)))
     JOIN public.subjects sub ON ((sub.subject_id = cs.subject_id)))
     JOIN public.users u ON ((u.user_id = fsa.faculty_user_id)))
  GROUP BY fsa.faculty_user_id, u.full_name, o.term_id, o.academic_year_id;


ALTER VIEW public.v_faculty_workload OWNER TO postgres;

--
-- Name: v_student_profiles; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: postgres
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_student_profiles AS
 SELECT s.student_id,
    s.usn,
    u.full_name,
    u.email,
    u.phone_number,
    p.name AS program_name,
    p.code AS program_code,
    b.batch_year,
    sec.name AS section_name,
    s.current_semester_number,
    s.cgpa,
    s.status,
    uni.name AS university_name
   FROM (((((public.students s
     JOIN public.users u ON ((u.user_id = s.user_id)))
     JOIN public.programs p ON ((p.program_id = s.program_id)))
     JOIN public.batches b ON ((b.batch_id = s.batch_id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.sections sec ON ((sec.section_id = s.section_id)))
     JOIN public.universities uni ON ((uni.university_id = s.university_id)));


ALTER VIEW public.v_student_profiles OWNER TO postgres;

20260317113016	{"\n-- STEP 1: Create a function to calculate current semester based on batch year\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_current_semester()\nRETURNS TRIGGER AS $$\nDECLARE\n  batch_year INTEGER;\n  years_elapsed INTEGER;\n  calculated_semester INTEGER;\nBEGIN\n  -- Get the batch year for this student\n  SELECT b.batch_year INTO batch_year\n  FROM batches b\n  WHERE b.batch_id = NEW.batch_id;\n  \n  -- Calculate years elapsed since batch start (current year is 2026)\n  years_elapsed := 2026 - batch_year;\n  \n  -- Calculate semester: each year has 2 semesters, + 1 for the current semester in progress\n  -- So if 3 years have passed: (3 * 2) = 6 semesters\n  calculated_semester := years_elapsed * 2 + 1;\n  \n  -- Cap at maximum semesters for the program\n  SELECT LEAST(calculated_semester, p.total_semesters)\n  INTO calculated_semester\n  FROM programs p\n  WHERE p.program_id = NEW.program_id;\n  \n  -- Set the current_semester_number\n  NEW.current_semester_number := calculated_semester;\n  \n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;\n\n-- STEP 2: Drop existing trigger if it exists\nDROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_auto_calculate_semester ON students;\n\n-- STEP 3: Create trigger that runs on INSERT or UPDATE\nCREATE TRIGGER trg_auto_calculate_semester\nBEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON students\nFOR EACH ROW\nEXECUTE FUNCTION calculate_current_semester();\n\n-- STEP 4: Update all existing students to correct semester\nUPDATE students s\nSET current_semester_number = (\n  SELECT LEAST(((2026 - b.batch_year) * 2 + 1), p.total_semesters)\n  FROM batches b\n  JOIN programs p ON p.program_id = b.program_id\n  WHERE b.batch_id = s.batch_id\n);\n\n-- STEP 5: Verify the update\nSELECT \n  'Semester Auto-Calculation Setup Complete' as status,\n  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students WHERE current_semester_number IS NOT NULL)::text as students_updated;\n"}	auto_calculate_student_semester	puneethasshankar@gmail.com	\N	\N
20260317113225	{"\n-- STEP 1: Create a function that advances all students by one semester\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION advance_students_semester()\nRETURNS TABLE(students_advanced INT, message TEXT) AS $$\nDECLARE\n  advanced_count INT;\nBEGIN\n  -- Update all active students to next semester\n  UPDATE students\n  SET \n    current_semester_number = LEAST(current_semester_number + 1, \n      (SELECT p.total_semesters FROM programs p WHERE p.program_id = students.program_id))\n  WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'\n  AND current_semester_number < (SELECT MAX(total_semesters) FROM programs p WHERE p.program_id = students.program_id);\n  \n  GET DIAGNOSTICS advanced_count = ROW_COUNT;\n  \n  RETURN QUERY SELECT \n    advanced_count,\n    'All active students advanced by 1 semester. Last updated: ' || NOW()::TEXT;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;\n\n-- STEP 2: Create a table to track semester advancement history\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS semester_advancement_log (\n  log_id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,\n  advancement_date TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),\n  students_advanced INT,\n  status VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'SUCCESS',\n  notes TEXT,\n  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()\n);\n\n-- STEP 3: Create a function to be called at semester end\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION trigger_semester_advancement()\nRETURNS TABLE(students_advanced INT, message TEXT, log_entry TEXT) AS $$\nDECLARE\n  advanced_count INT;\n  log_message TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  -- Call the advancement function\n  SELECT students_advanced INTO advanced_count FROM advance_students_semester();\n  \n  log_message := 'Semester advancement executed. ' || advanced_count::TEXT || ' students advanced.';\n  \n  -- Log the advancement\n  INSERT INTO semester_advancement_log (students_advanced, status, notes)\n  VALUES (advanced_count, 'SUCCESS', log_message);\n  \n  RETURN QUERY SELECT advanced_count, log_message::TEXT, 'Check semester_advancement_log table for history';\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;\n\nSELECT 'Semester advancement functions created successfully' as status;\n"}	auto_semester_advancement	puneethasshankar@gmail.com	\N	\N
20260317113450	{"\n-- FIX: Update semester calculation to match correct timeline\n-- March 2026: Students are in EVEN semesters (6, 4, 2)\n-- Not odd semesters (7, 5, 3)\n\n-- STEP 1: Update the automatic calculation function\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_current_semester()\nRETURNS TRIGGER AS $$\nDECLARE\n  batch_year INTEGER;\n  years_elapsed INTEGER;\n  calculated_semester INTEGER;\nBEGIN\n  -- Get the batch year for this student\n  SELECT b.batch_year INTO batch_year\n  FROM batches b\n  WHERE b.batch_id = NEW.batch_id;\n  \n  -- Calculate years elapsed since batch start (current year is 2026)\n  years_elapsed := 2026 - batch_year;\n  \n  -- Calculate semester: each year has 2 semesters\n  -- So if 3 years have passed: (3 * 2) = 6 semesters\n  -- This will be the CURRENT semester (March is in the middle of sem 6, 4, 2)\n  calculated_semester := years_elapsed * 2;\n  \n  -- If calculated semester is 0 (for batch 2026), set to 1\n  IF calculated_semester < 1 THEN\n    calculated_semester := 1;\n  END IF;\n  \n  -- Cap at maximum semesters for the program\n  SELECT LEAST(calculated_semester, p.total_semesters)\n  INTO calculated_semester\n  FROM programs p\n  WHERE p.program_id = NEW.program_id;\n  \n  -- Set the current_semester_number\n  NEW.current_semester_number := calculated_semester;\n  \n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;\n\n-- STEP 2: Update all existing students with correct semester\nUPDATE students s\nSET current_semester_number = (\n  SELECT LEAST(\n    GREATEST((2026 - b.batch_year) * 2, 1),\n    p.total_semesters\n  )\n  FROM batches b\n  JOIN programs p ON p.program_id = b.program_id\n  WHERE b.batch_id = s.batch_id\n);\n\n-- STEP 3: Verify the fix\nSELECT 'Semester calculation fixed' as status;\n"}	fix_semester_calculation	puneethasshankar@gmail.com	\N	\N

' || advanced_count::TEXT || ' students updated.';\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;\n\nSELECT 'Semester advancement logic updated' as status;\n"}	fix_semester_advancement_logic	puneethasshankar@gmail.com	\N	\N

true),\n  (1, 'Data Science', 'DS', 'MAJOR', true),\n  (1, 'Cloud Computing', 'CLOUD', 'MAJOR', true),\n  (1, 'Cybersecurity', 'CYBERSEC', 'MAJOR', true)\nON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;\n\n-- CREATE 9 MINORS\nINSERT INTO specializations (university_id, name, code, spec_type, is_active)\nVALUES \n  (1, 'Finance Minor', 'FIN_MIN', 'MINOR', true),\n  (1, 'FinTech Minor', 'FINTECH_MIN', 'MINOR', true),\n  (1, 'Marketing Minor', 'MKT_MIN', 'MINOR', true),\n  (1, 'UX Research Minor', 'UXR_MIN', 'MINOR', true),\n  (1, 'Product Design Minor', 'PD_MIN', 'MINOR', true),\n  (1, 'Digital Media 'SOC_MIN', 'MINOR', true)\nON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;\n\n-- CREATE BATCH_SPECIALIZATIONS\nINSERT INTO batch_specializations (batch_id, specialization_id, available_from_semester, is_available)\nSELECT b.batch_id, s.specialization_id, 3, true\nFROM batches b\nCROSS JOIN specializations s\nWHERE b.program_id IN (SELECT program_id FROM programs WHERE name IN ('B.Tech', 'BCA', 'B.Sc'))\n  AND s.spec_type IN ('MAJOR', 'MINOR')\nON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;\n\n-- AUTO-ASSIGN MAJORS (one major per student in Sem 3+)\nWITH major_assignments AS (\n  SELECT \n    s.student_id,\n    bs.batch_spec_id,\n    sp.spec_type,\n    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.student_id ORDER BY sp.specialization_id) as rn\n  FROM students s\n  JOIN batches b ON b.batch_id = s.batch_id\n  JOIN batch_specializations bs ON bs.batch_id = b.batch_id\n  JOIN specializations sp ON sp.specialization_id = bs.specialization_id\n  WHERE s.current_semester_number >= 3\n    AND s.program_id IN (SELECT program_id FROM programs WHERE name IN ('B.Tech', 'BCA', 'B.Sc'))\n    AND sp.spec_type = 'MAJOR'\n)\nINSERT INTO student_specializations (student_id, batch_spec_id, spec_type, status)\nSELECT student_id, batch_spec_id, spec_type, 'APPROVED'::varchar\nFROM major_assignments\nWHERE rn = 1\nON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;\n\n-- AUTO-ASSIGN MINORS (one minor per student in Sem 3+)\nWITH s\n  JOIN batches b ON b.batch_id = s.batch_id\n  JOIN batch_specializations bs ON bs.batch_id = b.batch_id\n  JOIN specializations sp ON sp.specialization_id = bs.specialization_id\n  WHERE 20260317141714	{"\n-- Create curriculum structures with correct category IDs\n-- Category IDs: Core=1, Major=2, Elective=3, Minor=4\n\n-- Build curriculum mapping\nWITH subject_sem_mapping AS (\n  SELECT subject_id, subject_code, \n    CASE \n      WHEN subject_code IN ('CS_CORE_101', 'CS_CORE_102', 'CS_CORE_103', 'CS_CORE_104') THEN 1\n      WHEN subject_code IN ('CS_CORE_201', 'CS_CORE_202', 'CS_CORE_203', 'CS_CORE_204') THEN 2\n      WHEN subject_code IN ('CS_CORE_301', 'CS_CORE_302', 'CS_CORE_303', 'CS_CORE_304') THEN 3\n      WHEN subject_code IN ('AIML_301', 'DS_301', 'CLOUD_301', 'CYBER_301') THEN 3\n      WHEN subject_code IN ('FIN_MIN_301', 'FIN_MIN_302', 'FINTECH_MIN_301', 'FINTECH_MIN_302', 'MKT_MIN_301', 'MKT_MIN_302', 'UXR_MIN_301', 'UXR_MIN_302', 'PD_MIN_301', 'PD_MIN_302', 'DM_MIN_301', 'DM_MIN_302', 'ENTR_MIN_301', 'ENTR_MIN_302', 'PHIL_MIN_301', 'PHIL_MIN_302', 'SOC_MIN_301', 'SOC_MIN_302') THEN 3\n      WHEN subject_code LIKE 'OE_%' THEN 3\n      WHEN subject_code IN ('CS_CORE_401', 'CS_CORE_402', 'CS_CORE_403', 'CS_CORE_404') THEN 4\n      WHEN subject_code IN ('AIML_401', 'DS_401', 'CLOUD_401', 'CYBER_401') THEN 4\n      WHEN subject_code IN ('FIN_MIN_401', 'FIN_MIN_402', 'FINTECH_MIN_401', 'FINTECH_MIN_402', 'MKT_MIN_401', 'MKT_MIN_402', 'UXR_MIN_401', 'UXR_MIN_402', 'PD_MIN_401', 'PD_MIN_402', 'DM_MIN_401', 'DM_MIN_402', 'ENTR_MIN_401', 'ENTR_MIN_402', 'PHIL_MIN_401', 'PHIL_MIN_402', 'SOC_MIN_401', 'SOC_MIN_402') THEN 4\n      WHEN subject_code IN ('CS_CORE_501', 'CS_CORE_502', 'CS_CORE_503', 'CS_CORE_504') THEN 5\n      WHEN subject_code IN ('AIML_501', 'DS_501', 'CLOUD_501', 'CYBER_501') THEN 5\n      WHEN subject_code IN ('FIN_MIN_501', 'FIN_MIN_502', 'FINTECH_MIN_501', 'FINTECH_MIN_502', 'MKT_MIN_501', 'MKT_MIN_502', 'UXR_MIN_501', 'UXR_MIN_502', 'PD_MIN_501', 'PD_MIN_502', 'DM_MIN_501', 'DM_MIN_502', 'ENTR_MIN_501', 'ENTR_MIN_502', 'PHIL_MIN_501', 'PHIL_MIN_502', 'SOC_MIN_501', 'SOC_MIN_502') THEN 5\n      WHEN subject_code IN ('CS_CORE_601', 'CS_CORE_602', 'CS_CORE_603', 'CS_CORE_604') THEN 6\n      WHEN subject_code IN ('AIML_601', 'DS_601', 'CLOUD_601', 'CYBER_601') THEN 6\n      WHEN subject_code IN ('FIN_MIN_601', 'FIN_MIN_602', 'FINTECH_MIN_601', 'FINTECH_MIN_602', 'MKT_MIN_601', 'MKT_MIN_602', 'UXR_MIN_601', 'UXR_MIN_602', 'PD_MIN_601', 'PD_MIN_602', 'DM_MIN_601', 'DM_MIN_602', 'ENTR_MIN_601', 'ENTR_MIN_602', 'PHIL_MIN_601', 'PHIL_MIN_602', 'SOC_MIN_601', 'SOC_MIN_602') THEN 6\n      WHEN subject_code IN ('CS_CORE_701', 'CS_CORE_702', 'CS_CORE_703', 'CS_CORE_704') THEN 7\n      WHEN subject_code IN ('AIML_701', 'DS_701', 'CLOUD_701', 'CYBER_701') THEN 7\n      WHEN subject_code IN ('CS_CORE_801', 'CS_CORE_802', 'CS_CORE_803', 'CS_CORE_804') THEN 8\n      WHEN subject_code IN ('AIML_801', 'DS_801', 'CLOUD_801', 'CYBER_801') THEN 8\n      ELSE NULL\n    END as semester_number,\n    CASE \n      WHEN subject_code LIKE 'CS_CORE_%' THEN 1  -- Core\n      WHEN subject_code LIKE 'AIML_%' OR subject_code LIKE 'DS_%' OR subject_code LIKE 'CLOUD_%' OR subject_code LIKE 'CYBER_%' THEN 2  -- Major\n      WHEN subject_code LIKE '%MIN_%' THEN 4  -- Minor\n      WHEN subject_code LIKE 'OE_%' THEN 3  -- Elective\n      ELSE 1\n    END as category_id\n  FROM subjects\n  WHERE subject_code LIKE 'CS_CORE_%' OR subject_code LIKE 'AIML_%' OR subject_code LIKE 'DS_%' OR subject_code LIKE 'CLOUD_%' OR subject_code LIKE 'CYBER_%' OR subject_code LIKE '%MIN_%' OR subject_code LIKE 'OE_%'\n)\n-- Insert curriculum structures\nINSERT INTO curriculum_structures (semester_id, subject_id, category_id, is_mandatory)\nSELECT \n  sem.semester_id,\n  ssm.subject_id,\n  ssm.category_id,\n  (ssm.category_id = 1)  -- Only core is mandatory\nFROM subject_sem_mapping ssm\nJOIN semesters sem ON sem.semester_number = ssm.semester_number\n  AND sem.program_id IN (SELECT program_id FROM programs WHERE name IN ('B.Tech', 'BCA', 'B.Sc'))\nWHERE ssm.semester_number IS NOT NULL\nON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;\n\nSELECT 'Curriculum structures created: ' || COUNT(*) as status FROM curriculum_structures WHERE semester_id IS NOT NULL;\n"}	create_curriculum_with_correct_categories	puneethasshankar@gmail.com	\N	\N
20260317141725	{"\n-- ============================================================================\n-- STEP 2: CREATE SUBJECT OFFERINGS for all batches and semesters 1-6\n-- ============================================================================\n\nINSERT INTO subject_offerings (university_id, curriculum_id, batch_id, academic_year_id, term_id, current_enrollment, status)\nSELECT DISTINCT\n  1 as university_id,\n  cs.curriculum_id,\n  b.batch_id,\n  (SELECT academic_year_id FROM academic_years WHERE is_current = true LIMIT 1) as academic_year_id,\n  (SELECT term_id FROM terms ORDER BY term_id LIMIT 1) as term_id,\n  0 as current_enrollment,\n  'ACTIVE'::varchar as status\nFROM curriculum_structures cs\nJOIN semesters sem ON sem.semester_id = cs.semester_id\nJOIN batches b ON b.program_id = sem.program_id\nWHERE sem.semester_number BETWEEN 1 AND 6\n  AND b.program_id IN (SELECT program_id FROM programs WHERE name IN ('B.Tech', 'BCA', 'B.Sc'))\nON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- STEP 3: AUTO-ENROLL STUDENTS IN SUBJECTS UP TO THEIR CURRENT SEMESTER\n-- ============================================================================\n\nINSERT INTO student_subject_enrollments (university_id, student_id, offering_id, enrollment_type, status)\nSELECT DISTINCT\n  1 as university_id,\n  s.student_id,\n  so.offering_id,\n  'REGULAR'::varchar as enrollment_type,\n  'ENROLLED'::varchar as status\nFROM students s\nJOIN batches b ON b.batch_id = s.batch_id\nJOIN semesters sem ON sem.program_id = b.program_id AND sem.semester_number <= s.current_semester_number\nJOIN curriculum_structures cs ON cs.semester_id = sem.semester_id\nJOIN subject_offerings so ON so.curriculum_id = cs.curriculum_id AND so.batch_id = b.batch_id\nWHERE s.current_semester_number >= 1\n  AND s.program_id IN (SELECT program_id FROM programs WHERE name IN ('B.Tech', 'BCA', 'B.Sc'))\nON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- STEP 4: RANDOM ELECTIVE ASSIGNMENT (one different elective per student per semester)\n-- For each student in Sem 3+, assign random electives for Sem 3-6\n-- ============================================================================\n\nWITH elective_assignment AS (\n  SELECT \n    s.student_id,\n    sem.semester_number,\n    cs.subject_id,\n    so.offering_id,\n    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.student_id, sem.semester_number ORDER BY RANDOM()) as rn\n  FROM students s\n  JOIN batches b ON b.batch_id = s.batch_id\n  JOIN semesters sem ON sem.program_id = b.program_id AND sem.semester_number BETWEEN 3 AND 6\n  JOIN curriculum_structures cs ON cs.semester_id = sem.semester_id\n  JOIN subject_offerings so ON so.curriculum_id = cs.curriculum_id AND so.batch_id = b.batch_id\n  JOIN subjects subj ON subj.subject_id = cs.subject_id\n  WHERE s.current_semester_number >= sem.semester_number\n    AND subj.subject_code LIKE 'OE_%'\n    AND s.program_id IN (SELECT program_id FROM programs WHERE name IN ('B.Tech', 'BCA', 'B.Sc'))\n)\nDELETE FROM student_subject_enrollments \nWHERE offering_id IN (\n  SELECT offering_id FROM elective_assignment WHERE rn > 1\n);\n\nSELECT 'Subject Offerings and Student Enrollments created successfully!' as status;\n"}	create_subject_offerings_and_auto_enroll	puneethasshankar@gmail.com	\N	\N

20260317151027	{"\n-- Delete incomplete assignments\nDELETE FROM student_specializations;\n\n-- Create temp tables to assign majors and minors cyclically\n-- ASSIGN MAJORS: cycle through 4 majors\nINSERT INTO student_specializations (student_id, batch_spec_id, spec_type, status)\nWITH ranked_students AS (\n  SELECT \n    s.student_id,\n    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.student_id) as rn\n  FROM students s\n  WHERE s.current_semester_number >= 3\n    AND s.batch_id IN (SELECT batch_id FROM batches WHERE batch_year IN (2023, 2024, 2025))\n),\nranked_majors AS (\n  SELECT \n    bs.batch_spec_id,\n    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY bs.batch_spec_id) as major_num\n  FROM batch_specializations bs\n  JOIN specializations sp ON sp.specialization_id = bs.specialization_id\n  WHERE sp.spec_type = 'MAJOR'\n)\nSELECT \n  rs.student_id,\n  rm.batch_spec_id,\n  'MAJOR'::varchar,\n  'APPROVED'::varchar\nFROM ranked_students rs\nJOIN ranked_majors rm ON rm.major_num = ((rs.rn - 1) % 4) + 1;\n\n-- ASSIGN MINORS: cycle through 9 minors\nINSERT INTO student_specializations (student_id, batch_spec_id, spec_type, status)\nWITH ranked_students AS (\n  SELECT \n    s.student_id,\n    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.student_id) as rn\n  FROM students s\n  WHERE s.current_semester_number >= 3\n    AND s.batch_id IN (SELECT batch_id FROM batches WHERE batch_year IN (2023, 2024, 2025))\n),\nranked_minors AS (\n  SELECT \n    bs.batch_spec_id,\n    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY bs.batch_spec_id) as minor_num\n  FROM batch_specializations bs\n  JOIN specializations sp ON sp.specialization_id = bs.specialization_id\n  WHERE sp.spec_type = 'MINOR'\n)\nSELECT \n  rs.student_id,\n  rm.batch_spec_id,\n  'MINOR'::varchar,\n  'APPROVED'::varchar\nFROM ranked_students rs\nJOIN ranked_minors rm ON rm.minor_num = ((rs.rn - 1) % 9) + 1;\n\nSELECT 'Assignments Complete' as status;\n"}	assign_all_majors_minors_simple	puneethasshankar@gmail.com	\N	\N
